## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Mixed signals—SPY (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +7.59%) ABOVE TREND and VXX (1W: -3.24% | 1M: -6.09%) BELOW TREND point risk-positive, while HYG (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +0.04%) CORRECTION / LQD (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -0.58%) BELOW TREND show rising credit stress.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD showing degradation (HYG (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +0.04%) CORRECTION, LQD (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -0.58%) BELOW TREND). Fear easing: VXX (1W: -3.24% | 1M: -6.09%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND, while Stocks vs Bonds ↑ rising (SPY/TLT skew) confirms selective equity bid.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-tightening: Dollar strength ↑ flat | ABOVE TREND and Yield Curve ↓ falling (flattening) with TLT (1W: -0.52% | 1M: -1.67%) BELOW TREND—financial conditions not uniformly easing.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +20.32%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +6.89% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND. Cyclicals/Financials lag: Financials sector (1W: -1.05% | 1M: -1.24%) showing weakness; Style: Growth/Momentum leading.

**5. US vs Global?**
US outperforms: SPY (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +7.59%) ABOVE TREND, QQQ (1W: +3.76% | 1M: +14.55%) ABOVE TREND. Select EM strength: EEM (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +7.78%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +2.30% | 1M: +2.39%) ABOVE TREND, but EM/China ratios are trending lower.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Mixed: ARKK (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +8.69%) ABOVE TREND shows continued speculative interest, while IBIT (1W: -1.04% | 1M: +10.12%) CORRECTION signals short-term profit-taking in crypto exposure.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Refla­tion/industrial metals strong: CPER (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +9.92%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +19.18% | 1M: +15.04%) ABOVE TREND. Gold recovering: GLD (1W: +3.50% | 1M: -0.56%) RECOVERY.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Mixed-to-risk-off within energy: XLE (1W: -3.16% | 1M: +0.81%) CORRECTION and BNO (1W: -2.22% | 1M: +15.94%) CORRECTION, while UNG (1W: +2.54% | 1M: +2.15%) ABOVE TREND shows commodity-specific divergence.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: XLK (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +20.32%) ABOVE TREND and QQQ (1W: +3.76% | 1M: +14.55%) ABOVE TREND—tech leadership intact. DIVERGENCE (minor): multiple 1W vs 1M mismatches in BNO, SKYY, IBIT indicate tactical profit-taking, not a regime break.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor growth/momentum exposure: XLK (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +20.32%) ABOVE TREND, QQQ (1W: +3.76% | 1M: +14.55%) ABOVE TREND. Reduce exposure to defensive/utilities tilt: XLU (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND and monitor credit sensitivity via HYG (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +0.04%) CORRECTION.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Technology/semis — XLK (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +20.32%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +6.89% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Utilities/Energy — XLU (1W: -2.54% | 1M: -2.59%) BELOW TREND, XLE (1W: -3.16% | 1M: +0.81%) CORRECTION.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Copper/industrial metals — CPER (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +9.92%) ABOVE TREND, Silver — SLV (1W: +19.18% | 1M: +15.04%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Oil micro-structure — BNO (1W: -2.22% | 1M: +15.94%) CORRECTION.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD 0.80 (credit health pivot), XLK/XLF 3.4–2.0 range (growth vs value leadership pivot).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive with mixed risk signals from falling VXX and rising credit stress. Tech/semis showing strength—XLK (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +20.32%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +6.89% | 1M: +31.18%) ABOVE TREND. Key risk: rising credit stress (HYG/LQD) and several 1W/1M corrections (BNO, SKYY, IBIT) to monitor.
